scenarios.title: Access scanner setup form without prior session code
given: the user has no previously saved vendor code in their session
scenarios.when: the user requests the scanner setup page without an identifier
then: the scanner setup page is displayed
the vendor code input field is empty

scenarios.title: Access scanner setup form with existing vendor code from prior submission
given: the user has previously submitted a vendor code (e.g. VENDOR99) in their session
scenarios.when: the user requests the scanner setup page without an identifier
then: the scanner setup page is displayed
the vendor code input field is prefilled with the previously submitted vendor code (e.g. VENDOR99)

scenarios.title: Access scanner setup with identifier returning matching codes
given: an identifier (e.g. 101) is associated with one or more reference codes (e.g. CODEA, CODEB)
scenarios.when: the user requests the scanner setup page with the identifier (e.g. 101)
then: the code selection page is displayed
each matching reference code is presented as a selectable option
any HTML special characters in reference codes are safely encoded

scenarios.title: Access scanner setup with identifier returning no codes
given: an identifier (e.g. 999) has no matching reference codes
scenarios.when: the user requests the scanner setup page with the identifier (e.g. 999)
then: an error page is displayed indicating that the request failed
the error page displays the message 'That code didn't look right.'

scenarios.title: Submit vendor code configuration
given: the user is configuring scanner settings
scenarios.when: the user submits a vendor code (e.g. VENDOR99) to the scanner setup
then: a confirmation page is displayed showing the submitted vendor code (e.g. VENDOR99)
the submitted vendor code is retained in the user's session for subsequent setup visits
